[LERR.9.1] **Which faults, and in what order.** For a `TypeError` (rung 5) or
a `ComputationError` (rung 6) that reaches a surface ([LERR.1.4.11]), the engine
**must**, in this order: record the fault on the event trace ([RFCS.21.1]),
which delivers it to the integrator on the stream callback ([NCBK.2.8]), and
then assert its fault fact ([LERR.9.2], [LERR.9.3]). No further callback
follows the assertion. An `EngineError` (rung 7) is recorded and **must not**
be asserted: the tier it halts has no working memory left to
assert into. [LERR.9.6] names the one further exception.
